title: Can you go back to where you left off in a dream, if you wake up?
content: Curious how many of us that dream of this place are able to do this. If I am extremely groggy upon wakening from a lucid dream in mall world, I can usually go back to sleep and get back to where I was. It is usually the only reason for going back to sleep. I want to finish what I was doing or explore something further.
